The following observations were collected during experimentation on an aqueous sample:
- The sample solution is pale yellow and has a pH around 3.
- When a few drops of dilute HNO3 is added to the sample solution, it becomes almost colorless.
- When a few drops of dilute NH3 or HCl is added to the sample solution, it becomes even more yellow.

Assuming that all of the above statements are true, which of the following statements is true?
